program output › printf output appears i: The debugger never sends program output to the browser: serve.py has no handler for it, though the client listens for 'sendStdoutToUser'.
stepping › the first step shows the firs: serve.py runs one 'next' before sending the first state, so the first line of main is never shown.
stepping › the session ends when the pro: The server signals exit with '__iexit__', which the client never listens for, so the session stays open after the program ends.
stepping › stepping back still works aft: The session never ends on GDB (see 'the session ends when the program finishes'), so there is no end to step back from.
input › lines typed in the console reach: serve.py never implemented typed input ('send_stdin' only logs an error), so the program never gets the lines.
playback › rewind moves the timeline to: VisualiserController only updates the slider when the time is truthy, so seeking to 0 leaves it at the end.
sharing › a copied link reopens the same: Create Link is behind the inDev flag in globalStore, which is always false, so the button never shows.
